# Stanice Zbiroh Historical Research Archive

An evidence-led public research archive about Zbiroh railway station, the Borek industrial works, Hotel Borek, Bethel Henry Strousberg, Brandeis–Eisenschimmel, and the surrounding railway landscape in western Bohemia.

## Research principles

- Distinguish primary evidence, contemporary reporting, secondary accounts and unresolved hypotheses.
- Do not infer identity, kinship, ownership or succession from similar surnames alone.
- Preserve disputed dates and interpretations rather than silently reconciling them.
- Cite the individual archive page and its underlying sources.

## Citation

Suggested archive title: Stanice Zbiroh Historical Research Archive. Individual pages provide their own titles, evidence status and source links. Access dates should be recorded because the archive is revised as new evidence appears.
